controls.evidence: Anzens mints/burns USDA 1:1 against segregated USD reserves and Treasuries custodied at BitGo Trust, gated by KYC bank transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists on the Cardano native policy. On 2026-08-11, Koios policy_asset_list returned the single USDA asset under policy fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 with raw supply 4,452,382,510,000 at six decimals. A sampled mint transaction confirmed the PlutusV2 policy, an intent-spend script b09775cba66375b3287233c6f809036c066937d05254df82c2e4cfd3, and a reference datum containing key hashes b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358 and 57dc15b18a02c5ceedab40fc4c37dd4824a869983c7496c6e6516ba5. Koios returned no required_signers and no native script for either the mint or referenced setup transaction, so the datum alone does not establish which key authorizes minting, a threshold, or cap-changing power; canRaiseCap remains unknown rather than inferred. ODR-A6 lane Q re-read 2026-09-01 at Cardano tip block 13883821 / absolute slot 196691675 (epoch 652): policy_asset_list returns the same single asset 55534441 with raw supply 4,452,393,310,000 at six decimals, and the newest of 302 mint/burn events is 98b374560bb765e8993fe36abd3b6069058dbd7c56bacbe4ac4514fc4a8c4488 (+10.8 USDA, block 13826058, absolute slot 195514771, 2026-08-18). That transaction still spends the intent script b09775cba66375b3287233c6f809036c066937d05254df82c2e4cfd3, executes the USDA policy, and reads the same reference config b91c80748190c7280be0a41da2b80fd9690af6e174bca2e388476f8eea200b86#0; it exposes no required_signers and no native script, and its inline datum now decodes to a config map whose entry for key '0' is a single-signature constructor over key hash b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358 and whose entry for key '144' is a threshold constructor over the list [b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358, 57dc15b18a02c5ceedab40fc4c37dd4824a869983c7496c6e6516ba5] with the integer 1. The config also names a third executed script hash b14eef859117f48699d281d60e583f00881ba23a79ae6774c9ac1237, an auth asset class df1efbfea203d740ad1ac71b7a199f342568d667f2961a853a576c4c with empty name, and the trailing integers 600000 and 1. Reading those constructors as signature/threshold semantics would require decompiling the PlutusV2 policy, which is not reproducible from Koios alone, so the authorization threshold is still not established and canRaiseCap stays unknown; what the read does establish is that the on-chain configuration exposes at most a two-key set with a threshold integer of 1, which does not reproduce the issuer's claimed cold 3-of-7 arrangement. No numeric supply ceiling appears anywhere in the config, so the mint stays priced as unbounded.

review.evidence: Anzens is the sole USDA issuance backend on Cardano; issuer materials describe centralized 1:1 mint/redemption via KYC bank transfers against BitGo Trust-custodied reserves. FinCEN MSB registration is not prudential product supervision. USDA policy fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 is an immutable PlutusV2 script. The retained independent Koios observations include mint 0450900785fa6608eb5f18b4f481939af82512f05b574bc8e5c3fdfea7d5f6fc (181.64 USDA), and the 2026-09-01 replay of mint 98b374560bb765e8993fe36abd3b6069058dbd7c56bacbe4ac4514fc4a8c4488 at block 13826058 / slot 195514771, pinned against tip block 13883821 / slot 196691675. Those mints spend intent script b09775cba66375b3287233c6f809036c066937d05254df82c2e4cfd3 and read reference config b91c80748190c7280be0a41da2b80fd9690af6e174bca2e388476f8eea200b86#0. The newest scoped 2026-10-01 re-read of mint c11effdaa66d31b7ed95c1cec5716490391baed46cdc144d28d336b218eced8f at block 14008131 retains that reference. Its datum contains key hashes b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358 and 57dc15b18a02c5ceedab40fc4c37dd4824a869983c7496c6e6516ba5 plus the integer 1; Koios exposes no required_signers or native script. Without independently reproduced Plutus constructor-to-signature semantics, that does not verify a threshold, legal-entity-to-key attribution, or the issuer's cold 3-of-7 claim. The scoped authorization question therefore stays open and canRaiseCap stays unknown. No verified construction bounds durable unbacked issuance, so economicCapSemantics stays unknown under A11 rather than asserting collateral-only issuance. The authored direct issuer-backend ability conservatively compiles to capSemantics unbounded, claimImpairment unbounded, and economicLossScope global-claim; its unknown threshold does not erase that issuance exposure. Queue convergence review 2026-10-03 re-read the Anzens homepage and the linked Anzens monthly-attestation post: the issuer explicitly describes an independent accountant's report examining management assertions and verifying every USDA token is fully backed and accounted for, published monthly. This supports the retained periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision as reviewed issuer disclosures, not an independently inspected current report or prudential assurance. With those economic-control facts, deriveV9MintPosture resolves the authored backend to unbounded-reconciled even while authorization and cap-construction evidence remain incomplete. The curated annotation is therefore unbounded-reconciled, matching the published derived posture; no cap review, quorum protection, governance delay, or new Cardano pin is claimed.
